depiction.primary_object: rounded square frame with a right-pointing play triangle inside
modifiers: second tilted square frame stacked behind at bottom-left
depiction.composition: two overlapping stacked frames, front view

readings.meaning: video library, video collection, or playlist of videos
multiple video clips or footage batch
binge-watching a series or course videos

ambiguity: Easy to confuse with a single video player or media file icon at small sizes, though the stacked backing frame specifically signals multiple items, a library, or a playlist.

modifier_semantics.modifier: second tilted square frame stacked behind at bottom-left
modifier_semantics.meaning: plurality, collection, library, album, or queue of items

reasoning: The play triangle inside a frame stacked over a second tilted frame clearly communicates a video collection, playlist, or batch of video clips. It fits tasks about organizing footage, curating playlists, watching video series, or assembling slideshows, though it overlaps somewhat with a single-video or photo-album icon.
